In the Go repo at /bench/repo (the "memos" project, indexed in codebase-memory-mcp as project "memos"), answer with exact path:line citations. Search breadth: very thorough.

Q1 (h07): Trace how a browser's HTTP request for another user's profile image (avatar) reaches stored data. Find the route registration for the avatar URL (search for "avatar" in server/router), then each hop: the HTTP/gRPC handler symbol and file, any intermediate functions, down to the store/data layer call (e.g. store.GetUser reading AvatarURL) and where the bytes are decoded/served. List each hop as "symbol — path:line".

Q2 (h15): Memo visibility (who may view a memo: PRIVATE/PROTECTED/PUBLIC) is enforced in more than one server surface. Find EVERY distinct enforcement site — at least three. Look at: the gRPC memo service GetMemo/ListMemos (visibility checks / filters), the attachment/resource-serving HTTP handler (checking the parent memo's visibility before serving a file), memo relations, RSS feed generation, explore/list endpoints, any interceptor. Grep for "Visibility", "VisibilityPrivate", "VisibilityProtected", "workspace setting" disallow public. For each site cite path:line and briefly what it checks.

Return concise findings with citations.

content.text:
I have everything needed.

## Q1 — Avatar request path: browser → stored bytes

The URL the browser uses is produced server-side: gRPC `User` responses rewrite a base64 avatar into a relative file URL, and that URL is served by the Echo file server (there is **no** live `GetUserAvatar` RPC — `/memos.api.v1.UserService/GetUserAvatar` at `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/acl_config.go:25` is a stale ACL entry with no handler anywhere in the repo).

URL construction (why the browser requests `/file/users/{username}/avatar`):
- `convertUserFromStore` — `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/user_service_converters.go:16`; sets `AvatarUrl = fmt.Sprintf("/file/%s/avatar", userpb.Name)` at `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/user_service_converters.go:36` when the stored value is a base64 data URI (`extractImageInfo` check at :34), otherwise passes the raw URL through (:38)
- `BuildUserName` — `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/user_resource_name.go:13` (yields `users/{username}`, so the path is `/file/users/{username}/avatar`)

Request hops:
1. Route registration — `FileServerService.RegisterRoutes` — `/bench/repo/server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:121`, avatar route at `/bench/repo/server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:124` (`fileGroup.GET("/users/:identifier/avatar", s.serveUserAvatar)`, group `/file` at :122)
2. Wiring — `/bench/repo/server/server.go:81-82` (`fileserver.NewFileServerService(s.Profile, s.Store, s.Secret)` then `RegisterRoutes(echoServer)`); constructor at `/bench/repo/server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:111`
3. Handler — `FileServerService.serveUserAvatar` — `/bench/repo/server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:168`
4. Auth gate (private instances only) — `s.Profile.AllowAnonymous()` — `/bench/repo/server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:173` → `/bench/repo/internal/profile/profile.go:46` (true only when `InstanceURL` is set); when false, `getCurrentUser` — `/bench/repo/server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:708` → `Authenticator.AuthenticateToUser` — `/bench/repo/server/auth/authenticator.go:190` (Bearer/PAT, then refresh-token cookie); 401 at :179. Note: on an open instance any user's avatar is served anonymously — no per-viewer authorization on the target user.
5. Lookup by path param — `getUserByUsername` — `/bench/repo/server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:715` (called at :185), which is a straight `store.GetUser(ctx, &store.FindUser{Username: &identifier})` at `/bench/repo/server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:716`
6. Store layer — `Store.GetUser` — `/bench/repo/store/user.go:148` (ID-keyed cache at :150; username lookups always fall through) → `Store.ListUsers` — `/bench/repo/store/user.go:136` → driver
7. DB layer — `(*DB).ListUsers` — `/bench/repo/store/db/sqlite/user.go:88`; `avatar_url` in the SELECT list at `/bench/repo/store/db/sqlite/user.go:159`, scanned into `user.AvatarURL` at `/bench/repo/store/db/sqlite/user.go:189` (Postgres: `/bench/repo/store/db/postgres/user.go:179`; MySQL: `/bench/repo/store/db/mysql/user.go:170`)
8. Existence checks — `/bench/repo/server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:189` (404 user not found), `:192` (404 when `user.AvatarURL == ""`)
9. Decode — `parseDataURI` — `/bench/repo/server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:737` (called at :196); regex `dataURIRegex` at `/bench/repo/server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:98`, `base64.StdEncoding.DecodeString` at `/bench/repo/server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:744`
10. MIME allowlist — `avatarAllowedTypes` map at `/bench/repo/server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:75`, enforced at `/bench/repo/server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:201` (400 otherwise)
11. Serve bytes — `setSecurityHeaders` — `/bench/repo/server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:758` (called :205), `Content-Type`/`Cache-Control` at :206-207, then `c.Blob(http.StatusOK, imageType, imageData)` — `/bench/repo/server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:209`

Avatar data is stored inline in the `user.avatar_url` column as a base64 data URI (written via `update.AvatarURL` at `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/user_service.go:354`, validated at :337-352), so there is no blob/S3 hop.

## Q2 — Memo visibility enforcement sites

**A. gRPC memo service (central read gate)**
1. `checkMemoReadAccess` — `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:39`; archived-only-to-creator at :43-52; non-public requires auth at :55-60; `Private` requires `CreatorID == user.ID` at :63 (note: no admin bypass here, unlike the file server). Called from `GetMemo` at `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:356` and again for the parent memo at `:367`, and from `ListMemoComments` at `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service_comments.go:148`.
2. `ListMemos` query narrowing — `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:178`; anonymous → `VisibilityList = [PUBLIC]` at `:219`; authenticated → CEL filter `creator_id == N || visibility in ["PUBLIC","PROTECTED"]` at `:222-223`; other-user scope → `[PUBLIC, PROTECTED]` at `:225`. Archived listing forced to own memos at `:189-196`.

**B. Attachment / file serving (HTTP)**
3. `checkAttachmentPermission` — `/bench/repo/server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:650` (called from `serveAttachmentFile` at `:149`); unlinked attachments → creator/admin only at `:660`; parent memo fetched at `:666`; `Public` + `AllowAnonymous()` short-circuit at `/bench/repo/server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:677`; share-token bypass (valid, unexpired, memo-scoped) at `:684-689`; `Private` → creator or admin at `/bench/repo/server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:699`.
4. gRPC attachment access check — `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/attachment_service.go:445` (`Public` passes) and `:451` (`Private` → creator/superuser); unlinked-attachment creator check at `:425-434`.
5. `ListMemoAttachments` — `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_attachment_service.go:214` (non-public requires auth) and `:222` (`Private` → creator/superuser).

**C. Memo relations**
6. `batchConvertMemoRelations` — `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service_converter.go:173`; builds `memoFilter` = `visibility == "PUBLIC"` (anonymous) at `:184` / `creator_id == N || visibility in ["PUBLIC","PROTECTED"]` at `:186`, applied to both outgoing and incoming relation queries at `:196` and `:203`.
7. `ListMemoRelations` — `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_relation_service.go:109` and `:111`, same filter passed as `FindMemoRelation.MemoFilter` at `:116`/`:128`. Filter is compiled into SQL at `/bench/repo/store/db/sqlite/memo_relation.go:80-85`.
8. `ListMemoComments` relation filter — `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service_comments.go:158` / `:160` (in addition to the `checkMemoReadAccess` at `:148`).

**D. Feeds / crawlers**
9. RSS explore feed — `/bench/repo/server/router/rss/rss.go:90` (`VisibilityList: [PUBLIC]`); user feed — `/bench/repo/server/router/rss/rss.go:141`. Routes at `/bench/repo/server/router/rss/rss.go:68-69`. Caution: the RSS response is cached by key (`explore` / `user:<name>`) with no viewer dimension, which is safe only because it is public-only.
10. Sitemap — `FrontendService.getSitemapXML` — `/bench/repo/server/router/frontend/frontend.go:150` (`VisibilityList: [PUBLIC]`).

**E. Stats / explore aggregates**
11. `ListAllUserStats` — `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/user_service_stats.go:84` (anonymous → PUBLIC), `:86-88` (own-or-public/protected CEL filter), `:90` (other creator → PUBLIC+PROTECTED).
12. `GetUserStats` — `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/user_service_stats.go:218` / `:220`.

**F. Write/interaction paths that re-check visibility**
13. `ListMemoReactions` — `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/reaction_service.go:30` and `:38`; `UpsertMemoReaction` — `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/reaction_service.go:83`.
14. `CreateMemoComment` — `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service_comments.go:41` (private parent → creator/superuser), comment inherits parent visibility at `:52`.
15. `UpdateMemo` — comment memos are forced back to the parent's visibility at `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:462-464`.

**G. Push / notification surfaces**
16. SSE fan-out — `SSEClient.canReceive` — `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go:134`; `Private` → owner or admin at `:136`, unknown visibility denied at `:141`; event visibility populated at `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/sse_event_helpers.go:29-37`.
17. In-app notifications — `canViewerAccessMemo` — `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/user_service_notifications.go:302` (`Private` → owner at `:309`, `Protected` → any authenticated at `:312`), used at `:337`, `:342`, `:370`, `:385`.
